verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document Copilot generating a working app from a sketch, image, or PDF design. The only related item, docs-30, says some supported models are 'optimized for... multimodal inputs.' That describes a model property, not a documented design-to-app workflow, so it is adjacent and earns no credit. Because the axis applies to a coding agent, the lack of evidence yields 'none' rather than 'na'.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can generate a working app from a sketch, image, or PDF design
